name: landing-page
title: Landing Page
description: A one-page website for a small business — headline, three sections, contact details. One file, no build step, and nothing to upload alongside it.
post_deploy:
Your page is live at {{url}}

Open it, then:
  1. The words are in the `site` object at the top of src/index.js. Change them
     and deploy again — that is the whole editing story.
  2. The "Built with wawesome" line in the footer is yours to keep or delete.
     Nothing on the platform adds it back.
  3. Want your own address on it? Attach a domain from the dashboard.

There is no build and there are no files beside this one: the page is markup the
Function returns, so everything a visitor loads is in src/index.js.
